constraints: The path parameter 'nfInstanceID' is required and must conform to the TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/NfInstanceId schema.
The request body is required and must be application/json conforming to the '#/components/schemas/NFProfile' schema.
An NFProfile object must include the properties 'nfInstanceId', 'nfType' and 'nfStatus'.
An NFProfile must include at least one of the following: 'fqdn', 'ipv4Addresses', or 'ipv6Addresses'.
If present, 'collocatedNfInstances' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'heartBeatTimer' MUST be an integer with a minimum value of 1.
If present, 'plmnList' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'snpnList' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'sNssais' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'perPlmnSnssaiList' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'nsiList' MUST be an array of strings with at least 1 item.
If present, 'ipv4Addresses' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'ipv6Addresses' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'allowedPlmns' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'allowedSnpns' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'allowedNfTypes' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'allowedNfDomains' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'allowedNssais' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'allowedRuleSet' MUST be an object (map) with at least 1 property and each value must conform to the 'RuleSet' schema.
If present, 'priority' MUST be an integer between 0 and 65535 (inclusive).
If present, 'capacity' MUST be an integer between 0 and 65535 (inclusive).
If present, 'load' MUST be an integer between 0 and 100 (inclusive).

Several NFProfile map-type properties (for example 'udrInfoList', 'udmInfoList', 'ausfInfoList', 'amfInfoList', 'smfInfoList', 'upfInfoList', 'pcfInfoList', 'bsfInfoList', 'chfInfoList', 'udsfInfoList', 'nwdafInfoList', 'pcscfInfoList', 'hssInfoList', 'supportedVendorSpecificFeatures', 'aanfInfoList', 'easdfInfoList', 'nsacfInfoList', 'mbSmfInfoList', 'tsctsfInfoList', 'mbUpfInfoList', 'dcsfInfoList', 'mrfInfoList', 'mrfpInfoList', 'mfInfoList', 'adrfInfoList', 'nfSetRecoveryTimeList', 'serviceSetRecoveryTimeList') MUST have at least 1 property when present (minProperties = 1).
If present, 'nfServices' (deprecated) MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'nfServiceList' MUST be an object (map) with at least 1 property and each value must conform to the 'NFService' schema.
Default notification subscriptions in 'defaultNotificationSubscriptions', when present, MUST be an array with at least 1 item and each item MUST include 'notificationType' and 'callbackUri'.
If present, 'nfSetIdList' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'servingScope' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'scpDomains' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'hniList' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'supportedRcfs' MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
If present, 'supportedVendorSpecificFeatures' MUST be an object with at least 1 property and each property value MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
In the NFService object, the properties 'serviceInstanceId', 'serviceName', 'versions', 'scheme' and 'nfServiceStatus' are required.
In an NFService, 'versions' MUST be an array with at least 1 item when present.
In an NFService, if 'ipEndPoints' is present it MUST be an array with at least 1 item.
IpEndPoint includes a 'not' constraint: an IpEndPoint must not have both 'ipv4Address' and 'ipv6Address' properties present together.
IpEndPoint 'port', when present, MUST be an integer between 0 and 65535 (inclusive).
InterfaceUpfInfoItem requires 'interfaceType' and MUST include at least one of 'endpointFqdn', 'ipv4EndpointAddresses' or 'ipv6EndpointAddresses' (anyOf).
PortRange objects, when present, MUST include 'start' and 'end', and both MUST be integers between 0 and 65535 (inclusive).
RuleSet objects MUST include 'priority' and 'action'.
VendorId, when present, MUST match the pattern '^[0-9]{6}$' (six digits).

Where a property references an external schema (TS29571_CommonData.yaml or other referenced components), the value MUST conform to that referenced schema (for example Fqdn, Ipv4Addr, Ipv6Addr, DateTime, PlmnId, ExtSnssai, etc.) as defined in the referenced component.

constraints: The path parameter 'nfInstanceID' is required and must conform to the schema referenced by TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/NfInstanceId.
The request body is required and must be sent as 'application/json' containing an NFProfile object (schema reference '#/components/schemas/NFProfile').
The NFProfile object MUST be of type object.
The NFProfile object MUST contain the properties 'nfInstanceId', 'nfType', and 'nfStatus'.
The NFProfile object MUST contain at least one of the following properties: 'fqdn', 'ipv4Addresses', or 'ipv6Addresses' (anyOf constraint).
If present, 'collocatedNfInstances' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to the CollocatedNfInstance schema.
If present, 'heartBeatTimer' must be an integer with a minimum value of 1.
If present, 'plmnList' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/PlmnId.
If present, 'snpnList' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/PlmnIdNid.
If present, 'sNssais' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/ExtSnssai.
If present, 'perPlmnSnssaiList' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to '#/components/schemas/PlmnSnssai'.
If present, 'nsiList' must be an array of strings with at least 1 item.
If present, 'ipv4Addresses' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/Ipv4Addr.
If present, 'ipv6Addresses' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/Ipv6Addr.
If present, 'allowedPlmns' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/PlmnId.
If present, 'allowedSnpns' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/PlmnIdNid.
If present, 'allowedNfTypes' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to '#/components/schemas/NFType'.
If present, 'allowedNfDomains' must be an array of strings with at least 1 item.
If present, 'allowedNssais' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/ExtSnssai.
If present, 'allowedRuleSet' must be an object whose additional properties conform to '#/components/schemas/RuleSet' and it must have at least 1 property.
If present, 'priority' must be an integer between 0 and 65535 inclusive.
If present, 'capacity' must be an integer between 0 and 65535 inclusive.
If present, 'load' must be an integer between 0 and 100 inclusive.
If present, 'extLocality' must be an object with string values and at least 1 property when present.

When present, the various '*InfoList' and many other map-like properties (for example 'udrInfoList', 'udmInfoList', 'ausfInfoList', 'amfInfoList', 'smfInfoList', 'upfInfoList', 'pcfInfoList', 'bsfInfoList', 'chfInfoList', 'udsfInfoList', 'nwdafInfoList', 'nfServiceList', 'supportedVendorSpecificFeatures', etc.) are required to be objects whose additionalProperties conform to the referenced schemas and have at least 1 property (minProperties: 1) as specified.
If present, 'nfServices' (deprecated) must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to '#/components/schemas/NFService'.
If present, 'defaultNotificationSubscriptions' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to '#/components/schemas/DefaultNotificationSubscription'.
If present, 'nfSetIdList' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/NfSetId.
If present, 'servingScope' must be an array of strings with at least 1 item.

If present, 'nfSetRecoveryTimeList' and 'serviceSetRecoveryTimeList' must be objects whose additional properties conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/DateTime and each such map must have at least 1 property.
If present, 'scpDomains' must be an array of strings with at least 1 item.
If present, 'supportedVendorSpecificFeatures' must be an object with at least 1 property; each value must be an array with at least 1 VendorSpecificFeature item.
If present, 'hniList' must be an array with at least 1 FQDN item.
If present, 'sharedProfileDataId' must be a UUID-formatted string.
If present, 'shutdownTime' must conform to TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/DateTime.
If present, 'supportedRcfs' must be an array with at least 1 item and each item must conform to '#/components/schemas/RcfId'.

Many nested component properties referenced by NFProfile delegate their own validation rules to their referenced schemas (for example '#/components/schemas/NFService', '#/components/schemas/IpEndPoint', '#/components/schemas/RuleSet', etc.), and those referenced-schema constraints apply when those properties are present.

parameters.description: Unique ID of the NF Instance to deregister

constraints: The path parameter 'nfInstanceID' is required.
The 'nfInstanceID' path parameter must conform to the schema referenced at 'TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/NfInstanceId'.
This operation does not define a request body; no request body is required for the DELETE request.
The caller must be authorized using the oAuth2ClientCredentials security scheme with the scope 'nnrf-nfm:nf-instance:write'.

schema.description: Information of a subscription to notifications to NRF events, included in subscription requests and responses

constraints: The request body MUST be present and MUST conform to the SubscriptionData schema.
The nfStatusNotificationUri property is required in the SubscriptionData request body.
The request body content type for the subscription creation MUST be application/json.
If sharedDataIds is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 item.
The subscriptionId property, when present, MUST match the regular expression '^([0-9]{5,6}-(x3Lf57A:nid=[A-Fa-f0-9]{11}:)?)?[^-]+$'.
The subscriptionId property is marked as readOnly, indicating it is provided by the server (response) rather than the client (request).

If reqNotifEvents is present, it MUST be an array and MUST contain at least 1 item, each item being one of the NotificationEventType enum values (e.g. NF_REGISTERED, NF_DEREGISTERED, NF_PROFILE_CHANGED, SHARED_DATA_CHANGED).
If reqSnssais is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 ExtSnssai item.
If reqPerPlmnSnssais is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 PlmnSnssai item.
If reqPlmnList is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 PlmnId item.
If reqSnpnList is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 PlmnIdNid item.
If servingScope is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 string item.
The requesterFeatures property is writeOnly and is defined by the SupportedFeatures schema, meaning it can be provided by the client in the request (but will not be returned in read responses).
The nrfSupportedFeatures property is readOnly and is defined by the SupportedFeatures schema, meaning it is provided by the server (not by the client in the request).

extPreferredLocality, when present, MUST be an object containing at least one property; each property value MUST be an array of LocalityDescription items and each such array MUST contain at least 1 item.
completeProfileSubscription is a boolean with default false and is writeOnly (can be provided by the client).

subscrCond, if present, MUST conform to one of the SubscrCond variants (oneOf): NfInstanceIdCond, NfInstanceIdListCond, NfTypeCond, ServiceNameCond, ServiceNameListCond, AmfCond, GuamiListCond, NetworkSliceCond, NfGroupCond, NfGroupListCond, NfSetCond, NfServiceSetCond, UpfCond, ScpDomainCond, NwdafCond, NefCond, or DccfCond.
If subscrCond is NfInstanceIdCond, the nfInstanceId property is required.
If subscrCond is NfInstanceIdListCond, the nfInstanceIdList property is required and it MUST contain at least 1 item.
If subscrCond is NfTypeCond, the nfType property is required, and the schema explicitly prohibits presence of nfGroupId or the pair conditionType + nfGroupIdList in that variant.
If subscrCond is ServiceNameCond, the serviceName property is required.

If subscrCond is ServiceNameListCond, both conditionType and serviceNameList properties are required and conditionType MUST have the value 'SERVICE_NAME_LIST_COND', and serviceNameList MUST contain at least 1 item.
If subscrCond is AmfCond, at least one of amfSetId or amfRegionId MUST be present.
If subscrCond is GuamiListCond, guamiList is required and it MUST contain at least 1 item.
If subscrCond is NetworkSliceCond, snssaiList is required and it MUST contain at least 1 item; if nsiList is present it MUST contain at least 1 item.
If subscrCond is NfGroupCond, both nfType and nfGroupId are required and nfType is restricted to the enum [UDM, AUSF, UDR, PCF, CHF, HSS, BSF, UDSF].
If subscrCond is NfGroupListCond, conditionType, nfType and nfGroupIdList are required and conditionType MUST have the value 'NF_GROUP_LIST_COND' and nfGroupIdList MUST contain at least 1 item.
If subscrCond is NfSetCond, nfSetId is required.
If subscrCond is NfServiceSetCond, nfServiceSetId is required.
If subscrCond is UpfCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'UPF_COND'.
If subscrCond is NwdafCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'NWDAF_COND'.
If subscrCond is NefCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'NEF_COND'.
If subscrCond is DccfCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'DCCF_COND'.
notifCondition, if present, MUST NOT contain both monitoredAttributes and unmonitoredAttributes at the same time (the schema disallows both being present simultaneously).

The nfStatusNotificationUri value provided in the request body is used as the callback endpoint for notifications (the callback definition uses '{$request.body#/nfStatusNotificationUri}' as the callback URI to POST NotificationData).
The request body must be a JSON object conforming to the NotificationData schema ($ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationData').
The request body content type must be 'application/json'.
The NotificationData object requires the 'event' and 'nfInstanceUri' properties.
The 'event' property must be one of the NotificationEventType values: NF_REGISTERED, NF_DEREGISTERED, NF_PROFILE_CHANGED, or SHARED_DATA_CHANGED.
If 'event' is 'NF_PROFILE_CHANGED', then at least one of 'nfProfile', 'profileChanges', or 'completeNfProfile' must be present in the NotificationData object.
If 'event' is 'NF_REGISTERED', then at least one of 'nfProfile' or 'completeNfProfile' must be present in the NotificationData object.
If 'event' is 'SHARED_DATA_CHANGED', then 'sharedDataChanges' must be present in the NotificationData object.
When present, 'profileChanges' must be an array with at least one item and each item must conform to ChangeItem ($ref: 'TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/ChangeItem').
When present, 'sharedDataChanges' must be an array with at least one item and each item must conform to ChangeItem ($ref: 'TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/ChangeItem').
If 'nfProfile' is present, it must conform to NFProfile ($ref: '#/components/schemas/NFProfile').

When 'nfProfile' is included in a notification, the nfProfile object and any NFService objects contained in nfProfile.nfServices (array items) or nfProfile.nfServiceList (additionalProperties) must not include the properties allowedPlmns, allowedSnpns, allowedNfTypes, allowedNfDomains, or allowedNssais (i.e. those properties are not permitted in the nfProfile or its NFService entries for the notification).
The callback request may include a 'Content-Encoding' header of type string (Content-Encoding, described in IETF RFC 9110).
